items.brief: Brazil's stock exchange pushes stablecoin launch back to 2027
items.why: Delayed real-backed stablecoin shows tokenized cash infrastructure timelines slipping.

items.brief: Next ECB chief favors tokenized bank deposits over stablecoins and bitcoin
items.why: Incoming ECB leadership's stance could shape EU tokenization and stablecoin rules.

items.brief: Injective asks SEC to allow order books for tokenized stock trading
items.why: Pushes regulator to broaden which blockchain systems can trade tokenized stocks.

items.brief: Brazil's stock exchange teams with major banks for real-pegged stablecoin
items.why: Exchange-issued tokenized cash could underpin onchain settlement in Brazil.

items.brief: Bank of Japan official: stablecoins need reserve rules for 'singleness of money'
items.why: Central bank signals reserve safeguards for stablecoins and tokenized deposits.

items.brief: Tether can freeze stolen crypto in minutes; recovery can take years
items.why: Shows limits of tokenized asset freezing versus actual restitution for holders.

items.brief: Ripple's lending plan nears use of XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
items.why: Shows stablecoin liquidity on a ledger being tied to a lending system.

items.brief: EU banking regulator concerned about DeFi impact on investors and stablecoins
items.why: EBA scrutiny of DeFi could affect MiCA-regulated stablecoin oversight.

items.brief: Nasdaq exec pushes for common EU rules on tokenized securities
items.why: Exchange advocacy and DLT license point toward regulated tokenized securities in EU.
